checks.label: ENTAILED
checks.rationale: The business_in_hong_kong fact requires case-specific judgment using occupation or duty, continuity, profit capability and purpose, while expressly preserving the non-exhaustive and qualified nature of those considerations.
representation_quotes: business_carried_on_in_hong_kong: The same business providing the assessed services is carried on in Hong Kong, as determined from the circumstances. This is not merely the location of clients, shared premises or an unrelated business. (truth value)

services_provided_as_business: The assessed office is carrying on a business in providing those same services. Supply through case-specific judgment considering occupation or duty requiring attention, continuity, capacity for profit and profit purpose, without treating the list as an exhaustive conjunction. Retain the genuine single-family arrangement, reimbursement, profit-objective and ordinary-course qualifications; unresolved wording or evidence leaves this fact unknown. (truth value)

source_evidence.quote: What amounts to “carrying on a business in Hong Kong” is not defined in the Ordinance and will need to be determined by reference to the facts of each case, including whether the person is performing an occupation or a duty which requires attention; the activity involves continuity; the activity is capable of making profit; and the activity was carried out for the purpose of making profit.

A genuine single family office arrangement, established to serve the investment needs of members of a single family, which is not being run as a business (i.e. not receiving any income, other than reimbursement of operating expenses from the family) or have the pursuit of profit as its business objective, should not in the ordinary course be considered as carrying on a business from a licensing perspective.
